# The Independent

> > The Independent is a British digital news outlet delivering global news, sports, opinion, and lifestyle coverage with focus on UK, US politics, international affairs, and major sporting events.

The Independent provides comprehensive journalism across politics (Donald Trump, UK government), international news (Iran, Israel, India, Australia), Premier League football, Olympic sports (Team GB cycling), and lifestyle topics including travel guides and home improvement. Features columnists, video news via Independent TV, and special campaigns like AIDSFREE.

## Key Topics

- UK Politics and News
- US Politics and Donald Trump
- International Affairs (Iran, Israel, India, Australia)
- Team GB and Olympic Sports
- Cycling (Track Cycling, Mountain Biking)
- Premier League Football
- Asia Regional Coverage
- Travel Guides and Hotels
- Climate and Home Improvement
- Political Commentary and Columnists
- Independent TV Video News
- Geopolitics and South Asia
- Chelsea FC and Aston Villa
- Matt Richardson and Charlie Tanfield

## News and Politics

- [Independent Asia Edition](https://www.the-independent.com/asia): Regional Asia news coverage including Nepal, Australia, and geopolitics
- [Columnists](https://www.the-independent.com/voices/columnists): Opinion columns featuring political commentary and analysis from experts
- [7 in 10 Americans believe Trump's tariffs have caused higher prices](https://www.the-independent.com/us/money/trump-tariffs-americans-poll-b2938291.html): Harris Poll shows 70% of Americans link Trump tariffs to price increases
- [DOGE lead defends DEI grant denials](https://www.the-independent.com/tv/news/doge-bros-dei-nathan-cavanaugh-deposition-video-b2938190.html): Nathan Cavanaugh defends DOGE team's DEI grant cancellations under Trump order
- [Tucker Carlson feuds with Laura Loomer over antisemitism accusations](https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/tucker-carlson-laura-loomer-antisemitism-b2938197.html): Tucker Carlson responds to Laura Loomer's antisemitism and Qatar allegations

## Sports Coverage

- [Olympic Cycling](https://www.the-independent.com/sport/olympics/cycling): Olympic cycling news featuring Team GB, Matt Richardson, and Charlie Tanfield
- [Aston Villa](https://www.the-independent.com/sport/football/premier-league/aston-villa): Aston Villa news with Unai Emery, Ollie Watkins, and Premier League updates

## Travel Guides

- [Belfast Travel Guide](https://www.the-independent.com/travel/uk/northern-ireland/belfast): Belfast travel guide covering hotels and Northern Ireland city breaks
- [Bath Travel Guide](https://www.the-independent.com/travel/uk/england/bath): Bath spa hotels and UK city break guide featuring Bridgerton locations
- [Belarus Travel Guide](https://www.the-independent.com/travel/europe/belarus): Belarus and Minsk travel destination guide for Europe travelers

## Home and Lifestyle

- [Are solar panels worth buying in the UK](https://www.the-independent.com/home-improvement/solar-panels/are-solar-panels-worth-it-b2843310.html): UK solar panel ROI guide covering Smart Export Guarantee and installation
- [Natural materials that regulate temperature at home](https://www.the-independent.com/home-improvement/natural-materials-regulate-temperature-home-b2937847.html): Guide on using wool, cork, clay for energy-efficient temperature regulation

## Special Coverage

- [AIDSFREE Campaign](https://www.the-independent.com/aidsfree): AIDS awareness campaign with Elton John AIDS Foundation and NHS testing
- [World's rarest sea turtle rescued in Texas](https://www.the-independent.com/bulletin/news/kemps-ridley-sea-turtle-washes-ashore-texas-b2938183.html): Endangered Kemp's ridley sea turtle rescued on Texas coast near Galveston
